title: Vijnana Aranya, Chiguru Srujana Shaale Visit to Bengaluru
teaser: Three-day Vijnana Aranya outreach visit for students of Chiguru Srujana Shaale, Hosabidarahalli, to Bengaluru: VITM, Raman Museum, and IASc, 30 October – 1 November 2025.
homepageMatter: Students of Chiguru Srujana Shaale, Hosabidarahalli, visited Bengaluru for a three-day Vijnana Aranya (30 October – 1 November 2025), including a curated tour of VITM, the Raman Museum, and IASc, with Harate sessions by V.S.S. Sastry and talks by Achutha and Anandaram.
